limitations: Retrospective pilot of three real fixes in one controller session, not three independent SDD agent trials.
Implementation/review/wait phases were not instrumented at the time; null means unmeasured, not zero.
Request usage is attributed by observed timestamp windows, not causal task ownership; mixed-task requests can contain shared work.
No separate reviewer/subagent was used in these fixes. First request is session-level, not first request per task.
No pre-change matched task sample exists, so these measurements cannot establish end-to-end workflow speedup.
Recorded cache creation zero is the local log value, not a claim about provider billing.
No-duplicate count covers captured runs only; historical non-runner invocations are outside this inventory.
